days.title: Hills and Natural Springs
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Tibidabo
stops.detail: Of the numerous hills that make up its profile, Tibidabo is the highest (512 m).

stops.name: Font Groga
stops.detail: Within the park boundaries there are areas of interest such as the Font Groga partial natural reserve or the Riada-Can Balasc.

stops.name: Fuente de la Budellera
stops.detail: There are a large number of springs such as the Budellera Spring and the Ribas Spring.
